description: Ten portfolios built to span geopolitical risk from ~0 to ~100 (one per decile). Same moderate profile for all, so the objective score differs only through the holdings. Used by tests/test_risk_ladder.py (scores the inputs captured from real app runs) and scripts/risk_ladder.py (runs them through the app).

portfolios.why: Canadian ultra-short government bonds: one stable G7 country, no company risk.
Canadian bonds plus domestic utilities and banks: home country only, low-risk companies.
Canada/US 60-40: two stable countries, diversified, consumer staples.
Developed-market equities (US, Europe, Japan): stable countries, broad company mix.
US mega-cap tech: stable home country but China/Taiwan supply chains and export-control exposure.
Semiconductors: Taiwan and Korea manufacturing, China revenue, export controls.
Broad emerging markets: India, Brazil, Indonesia, Mexico, EM sovereign debt.
Frontier and fragile: Nigeria, Egypt, South Africa, Turkey, Argentina.
China and Taiwan concentration: sanctions, delisting, Taiwan Strait, capital controls.
Active conflict and sanctions exposure: Israel at war, Turkey, Nigeria/Egypt, China tech, crypto.
